for_you.ask: 🎬 Post a video from the stand today
for_you.detail: Open the library (people/silvio/videos/), pick one of the thirteen, press Copy text and Share (phone) or Download. On LinkedIn, reshare RiskMandate's post with one line of your own (WS-126). Don't post the 53-second Reach, Mandate, Gap, fifty new agents or the X-ray company videos. Then tell me the post's public link and I record it for Silvio's agent.
for_you.recommend: Today: 'The demo is us' (0:47) or 'The X-ray, a real run' (0:30) fit the stand.

for_you.ask: 🔑 crm: 'the token is set', and its company sites
for_you.detail: crm still holds your 31 connections in 6 unpushed vault commits, and none of your eleven companies is added. Say 'the token is set' in its session (or to me), and allow the eleven companies' domains in its environment's network settings.
for_you.recommend: Now, if you want the CRM at the stand; otherwise after the summit.
